hits.snippet: Bernadette Nixon is the CEO of NetBrain, where she leads the company’s mission to help global enterprises prevent network outages and reduce MTTR with AI-powered automation. She brings more than two decades of experience scaling high‑growth software companies and building customer‑centric, high‑performing teams across the infrastructure and content management markets. Previously, Bernadette served as CEO of Algolia, the AI‑powered search and discovery platform, where she drove global expansion, major funding, and strategic acquisitions. hits.snippet: # Blackstone Closes Majority Investment In NetBrain As Bernadette Nixon Takes Over As CEO By Amit Chowdhry • Jan 20, 2026 [Pulse 2.0](https://pulse2.com "Pulse 2.0") Blackstone Closes Majority Investment In NetBrain As Bernadette Nixon Takes Over As CEO [Follow Pulse 2.0 on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/pulse2news) Blackstone Growth has closed its previously announced majority investment in NetBrain Technologies, with the AI NetOps platform provider saying the funding will accelerate global expansion and advance its AI-powered network automation capabilities. Alongside the transaction close, NetBrain announced a CEO transition and several board changes. Bernadette Nixon has been appointed chief executive officer and will join the company’s board. Founder Lingping Gao will step down as CEO and become chair of the board after leading the company for roughly two decades. NetBrain also named Gus Malezis, an executive strategic advisor and chairman of IRIS Software Group, and Jerry Guo, founder, former CEO and chairman of Casa Systems, to its board of directors.
